```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggpicrust2)
library(GGally)
library('pheatmap')
```

## Load physloseq and rarefaction

```{r load_data}
meta = readRDS("ps.rds") %>%
  .@sam_data %>% data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_name")

ko = read.delim("pred_metagenome_unstrat.tsv", row.names=1)

```

# Differential Analysis

```{r}
#Healthy (control) in male and female filtered for antrum

HC_difference = meta %>%
  filter(Group == "Healthy control (HC)") %>%
  filter(Site == "gastric antrum")

ko_filt_HC = ko %>% select(all_of(HC_difference$sample_name))

daa_results_df_HC = pathway_daa(abundance = ko_filt_HC,
                             metadata = HC_difference,
                             group = "Gender",
                             daa_method = "LinDA",
                             select = NULL, reference = NULL)

daa_annotated_results_df_HC = pathway_annotation(pathway = "KO",
                                              daa_results_df = daa_results_df_HC,
                                              ko_to_kegg = TRUE)

saveRDS(daa_annotated_results_df_HC, "daa_annotated_results_df_HC_antrum.rds")
daa_annotated_results_df_HC = read_rds("daa_annotated_results_df_HC_antrun.rds")


#Chronic Gastiritis (CG) in male and Female filtered for antrum

  filter(Group == "Chronic gastritis (CG)")%>%
  filter(Site == "gastric antrum")

                                              ko_to_kegg = TRUE)

daa_annotated_results_df_CG = read_rds("daa_annotated_results_df_CG_antrum.rds")
```
